## Background

- 2026 – present: M.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Washington, Seattle
- Jan 2026 – Jul 2026: AI Software Engineer Intern, Apple
- 2022 – 2026: B.S. in Software Engineering, Wuhan University
- Reviewer, Applied AI Letters (2025); Teaching Assistant, Advanced Programming, Wuhan University (Fall 2023)

## Projects

- [MemServe](https://github.com/PhysFlow/ServerlessLLMonSuperchips): serving models larger than MIG memory on NVIDIA MIG instances with SGLang. A HybridGEMM kernel computes on weights kept in CPU memory, a runtime tunes the GPU/CPU split online from HBM and host-link load, and a serverless control plane places models on SGLang workers on demand.
